cases.evidence: Market Radar owns curated no-address selection; focused raw ranking packages remain separate.
Observed fixed five-source order: EP-002 24h, EP-002 1h, EP-002 5m, EP-005 1h trending, EP-008 1d smart money.
Empty primary fixture made one request, returned zero tokens and policy-skipped four later sources.
Repeated source rows collapsed to one validated address with source ranks retained.
Local market-cap, liquidity and seven-day listing gates ran after fetch; unknown age was rejected.
Nine versioned component weights total 100; unavailable components remain null and add no points.
Score coverage and score floor executed before output limit; result contained fewer than requested rows without padding.
Funnel exposed raw, unique, rejected, eligible, score-passing and listed counts plus near-miss reason.
Separate fixtures stopped later sources on call cap and rate limit; no hidden continuation occurred.
Control and markup characters were removed from attacker-controlled display text.
Compatible baseline produced new/stayed/dropped sets; malformed address rejected before the first request.
Every listed fixture candidate retained security_check=not_run and the package requires follow-up due diligence.

composed_live_run.credential_policy: Each user injects BIRDEYE_API_KEY in their own process environment; no key is bundled or accepted in skill input.
composed_live_run.effect_on_release: The deterministic flow and each underlying endpoint path passed, but a fresh integrated live radar run remains an explicit acceptance item.
